manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the top share the same motion afterwards. Gravity gives acceleration -g at every instant, including the top.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.description: Two lanes show a tossed ball and a second ball held by a gate at the apex height. The gate opens at the top. Arrows show velocity and acceleration.
